name: Employee Wise Attendance Summary
query:
SELECT 
    eam.employee AS "Employee ID:Link/Employee:150",
    eam.full_name AS "Employee Name:Data:200",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT project.project__object_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Project Name:Data:200",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT eam.object SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Object:Link/Objects:150",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT user.full_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Team Leader Name:Data:200",
    COUNT(DISTINCT eam.date) AS "Total Days:Int:100",
    SUM(eam.duration) AS "Total Hours:Float:100",
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN eam.allowance = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS "Allowance:Data:100"
    
FROM 
    `tabEmployee Attendance Master` eam
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabProject Setup` project ON eam.project = project.name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabUser` user ON project.team_leader = user.name
WHERE 
    eam.date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    eam.employee, eam.full_name
ORDER BY 
    eam.full_name;
